notes.en: [[character:dialyn]] builds CRIT Rate for King of the Summit and for her Core Passive, with Energy Regen to keep her EX Specials flowing. Her Ultimate conversion is one of her most valuable abilities.
Target stats at level 60: ATK 2,400+, HP 9,500+, DEF 800+, CRIT Rate 80 to 100% and CRIT DMG 100%+.

[[character:ye-shunguang]]: every Ye Shunguang Ultimate gives 6 Qingming Sword Force, so Dialyn's Ultimate conversion is one of the easiest ways to enter the Enlightened Mind State. [[character:yixuan]] is a perfect match: Dialyn has a low field time out of Stun and a strong Stun DMG Multiplier and duration extension in Stun.

[[character:yidhari]], [[character:manato]], [[character:banyue]], [[character:hugo]] and [[character:evelyn]] all benefit from her Stun DMG Multiplier, Stun extension and Ultimate conversion. She is easily the best Stunner for Yidhari, Manato and Banyue.

[[character:corin]], [[character:billy]] and [[character:nekomata]] benefit massively because Dialyn is a Physical agent and enables their Additional Abilities. All other Attackers, such as [[character:anton]], [[character:ellen]], [[character:harumasa]] and [[character:zhu-yuan]], also work very well with her.
